description: Get AI context pack for content generation. Recommended before creating tweets/posts. Also returns default_site (id, domain, and the rule "unless the user names another site, writes go to <domain>") when the account has one.

domain.description: Site domain to scope this call to (e.g. example.com). Alternative to site_id.

query.description: Optional topic hint for the content you are about to write. Accepted for compatibility; the context pack is not filtered by it.

site_id.description: Site UUID to scope this call to. Alternative to domain.

name: get_ai_context
title: Get AI Context
